summary: Make governance runtime acquisition independent of PyPI publisher configuration

delivery.outcome: Publish standard 0.20.47 with deterministic Git-tag runtime acquisition so adopter CI is independent of PyPI trusted publisher configuration.
nonGoals: Modify downstream adopters without their own ticket

architecture.decision: Pin runtime acquisition to the immutable standard repository tag derived from the adopted version. Keep PyPI as an observable optional channel and always publish the GitHub release asset after building.
interfaceChanges: Install runtime from wellman-v<standard> immutable tag
architecture.rollback: Publish a later corrective immutable standard version; never retag 0.20.46 or 0.20.47.

commands: python3 -c "import json, tomllib; assert open('VERSION').read().strip() == '0.20.47'; assert tomllib.load(open('packages/wellman/pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'] == '0.20.47'; assert json.load(open('governance/manifest.default.json'))['standard']['version'] == '0.20.47'; assert json.load(open('governance/manifest.hub.json'))['standard']['version'] == '0.20.47'"
validation.evidence: Version projections, package build, governance fixtures and whitespace validation pass.
